sentence: This project studies senescent hepatocytes that build up during nonalcoholic fatty liver disease and tests whether targeting the mechanisms behind their senescence improves the disease.
This project builds a pipeline that predicts how severe genetic mutations are when they lead to a specific type of cardiac disease.
This project studies how neutrophils in cardiovascular disease produce a cytokine and how cell death signaling works in these cells.
This project tries to find out which factors protect against small blood vessel complications of type 2 diabetes in the kidneys, eyes and brain.
This project builds large language models to compare the safety and effectiveness of drugs in people with Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project uses a large cancer registry to study how precision oncology drugs work for patients with rare mutations or rare cancers.
This project determines the 3D structures of target proteins using x-ray crystallography and electron microscopy to help with drug design.
This project tests an intervention designed for adult couples that aims to reduce new HIV infections and improve health outcomes.
This project tests whether a mobile health intervention helps adults with binge-spectrum eating disorders sense bodily sensations better and lowers their eating disorder symptoms.
This project tests whether transplanting neural progenitor cells, alone or with exercise, restores cardiac activity after spinal cord injury.
This project builds a malaria intelligence system and a mobile app to help forecast malaria outbreaks and plan prevention and control in Kenya.
This project looks for the variants, target genes and cell types behind proteinuric kidney diseases using kidney and immune cells from people.
This project develops a long-lasting gene therapy that targets bone for osteogenesis imperfecta, using a recombinant adeno-associated virus.
This project builds imaging tools, including intravital microscopy, to study the bone marrow during cardiovascular disease.
This project sets up shared research facilities with equipment for epigenomics, metabolomics, lipidomics and microbiomes to support precision nutrition research.
This project develops an ultrasound tool powered by artificial intelligence that measures microvasculature shape to diagnose eye cancer early.
This project studies how T-Type calcium channels help glioblastoma grow through the brain cells around the tumor.
This project uses computational modeling to understand how tumor cells and immune cells interact in advanced breast tumors and to improve immunotherapy.
This project tries to find out which progenitor cells persist postnatally in the human ventral forebrain and how germinal regions change.
This project studies how a fatal neurodegenerative disorder of childhood damages the enteric nervous system and how gene therapy can treat brain and bowel.
